Nope, I'm wrong about the colors.  The operative's tattoo is also blue.

 

As for why they are together- Expat is super-serious, focused, and driven.  Setback rolls with whatever life gives him, but doesn't have the most direction.  He helps her relax, she helps him stay focused.  

Expat comes from a really, really screwed up family dynamic.  She has severe trust issues when it comes to people with powers.  Setback doesn't even acknowledge that he HAS powers (things just happen, you know?) in his bio, and he's had a really hard life (including being shot by his to-be girlfriend). 

They've both spent a ton of time building up walls, denying that they have any powers, and keeping other people at a distance to keep them from getting hurt.  They both have a lot of growing up to do.  Maybe it was love at first shock, maybe it was when Setback got up and told her that it was OK, those kinds of things happened (and genuinely meant it).  Maybe it was later, after they both saw that there was someone a LOT deeper than their original impressions. 

I doubt its a super low maintenance relationship, but I think there could be a lot of love there.

2.  I agree.  Fixer is blind.

4-6.  No opinions on these.

9.  Expat and powers, I've been a firm member of the Expat has powers camp since I found out she didn't and played her deck.  She's my favorite hero, so I'm all about her having a big role in the story, but I don't think her powers ever get too big, It would defeat the character, but something subtle that has helped her pull off all the stuff she does without her even knowing about it at first.  I could see Setback and her being an item, but man, I don't think she would handle working too closely with him very well, she is tactical and has her own methods, someone screwing up her plans just by having bad luck doesn't seem like something she would appreciate, and I bet winning because he went super lucky suddenly would really piss her off.  I see their interaction being Setback causing havoc by being himself, and Expat out on the fringe taking advantage.  Unless this promo of Setback is much more stable than his original, in which case I'm all on board with the relationship, as I could see that kind of a thing happening and changing both of them.
